principle: Install useful plugins broadly; change system/performance behavior only when the benefit is understood and scoped.

CSS Loader.default: Install real Theme Store components and apply Bubble Gum Rave as supported settings; never install a standalone palette theme.
notes: Keep palette configuration versioned; obtain real components through CSS Loader Theme Store.
Refresh CSS Loader after Steam client updates if selectors change.
Use to repair artwork for Heroic, media, Moonlight, chiaki-ng, Android and emulation shortcuts.

ProtonDB Badges.default: Show compatibility information; no performance mutation.
notes: Treat ProtonDB as advisory, not an automatic compatibility override.

PowerTools.default: Install for visibility and per-game/emulator tuning, but leave all global CPU/SMT/GPU/power settings at SteamOS defaults.
notes: Use Persistent only for a tested per-game/emulator profile.
EmuDeck still documents SMT-off/manual-GPU tuning for some emulator workloads; apply only to the affected emulator/game after testing.
Never globally disable SMT, force GPU clocks, alter power limits, or set battery controls as part of provisioning.
Informational only.

AutoFlatpaks.default: Check for updates and show toast notifications; automatic unattended upgrading OFF.
notes: Apply updates manually when convenient.
Travel lock should avoid broad Flatpak upgrades immediately before/during trips.

Bluetooth.default: Install for QAM Bluetooth device control.
notes: Do not replace SteamOS Bluetooth management; this is a convenience surface.

Emuchievements.default: Install; connect RetroAchievements only if you use the service.
notes: No credential material belongs in the repo.

Non-Steam Badges.default: Install to visually identify non-Steam library entries.
notes: Useful with Heroic, media apps, Android, Moonlight and other shortcuts.

Animation Changer.default: Install; keep randomization OFF until a curated boot/suspend set is chosen.
notes: Future Bubble Gum Rave animation pack can be versioned separately.

Audio Loader.default: Install; keep stock sounds until a curated sound pack is selected.
notes: Future Bubble Gum Rave sound pack can be versioned separately.

MoonDeck.default: Do not install/configure by default. Standard Moonlight + Sunshine remains the core remote-gaming path.
notes: Install MoonDeck only if you want to launch specific host Steam games directly from the Deck library.
MoonDeck Buddy runs on the streaming PC and is required for MoonDeck integration.
Moonlight/Sunshine continue to work without MoonDeck.

Deck Settings.default: Install and use as advisory game-specific performance/compatibility reference.
notes: Do not automatically apply community settings; use them as input to tested per-game profiles.

Deck Shelves.default: Optional library/home-screen organization after the core UI is stable.
notes: Good fit if the unified Steam library becomes crowded.

Tailscale Control.default: Optional QAM control only after the underlying Tailscale service is healthy.
notes: Never use it as the Tailscale installer or source of truth.

Storage Cleaner.default: Optional visibility/cleanup tool; never auto-delete shader cache or compatdata.
notes: Compatdata can contain non-cloud saves. Always inspect before deleting.

vibrantDeck.default: Visible in the optional list but do not install by default on OLED.
notes: Prefer Valve native color controls unless you intentionally want additional saturation.

Fantastic.default: Visible in the optional list; do not install/apply a fan curve by default.
notes: Prefer Valve fan control; only use a custom curve after temperature/noise testing.
Useful only if you want stricter automatic suspend behavior than SteamOS already provides.

EmuDecky.default: Install for EmuDeck hotkeys, Quick Settings and emulator-update access in Game Mode.
notes: If EmuDeck already installed it as part of another feature, deckctl should simply detect it.
Do not duplicate save-sync ownership; deckctl backup remains the safety layer.

Battery Tracker.default: Optional. No system mutation; use for battery history/power visibility.

Pause Games.default: Optional. Keep automatic pause-on-focus-loss OFF by default.
notes: Some games do not tolerate repeated SIGSTOP/SIGCONT well; enable per need and save often.

Volume Mixer.default: Optional per-application volume convenience in Game Mode.

BetterKeyboard.default: Optional on-screen keyboard convenience; install only if stock keyboard behavior bothers you.

Controller Tools.default: Install controller battery/status utilities; preserve existing controller profiles.
notes: Use the plugin interface for personal preferences.

Game Theme Music.default: Install game-page music support; preserve existing audio settings.
notes: Use the plugin interface for personal preferences.

MagicPods.default: Install supported earbud battery/control integration; preserve pairings and device settings.
notes: Use the plugin interface for personal preferences.

TabMaster.default: Install library tab customization; preserve existing tabs and filters.
notes: Use the plugin interface for personal preferences.
